cells.note: Rescored under Bill's ruling of 2026-10-31 (messages-for-bill 58): The law conditions transfers outside CEMAC and ECCAS on sufficient protection in the recipient state [CAF-001], which answers question 1. Whether any transfer goes without permission is not held, so the stage is 2.
